subject: Midweek signalline: wins, hazards, and QBR-ready asks
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Leadership Distro <leadership@redwood.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 19 May 2027 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Midweek signalline: wins, hazards, and QBR-ready asks

Team — midweek quick read with three sections (wins / risks / asks). Trying to keep this tight so folks can forward into QBR slides where helpful.

Wins:
- Acme POC: core latency targets met in dedicated test (p95 120ms, cost within expected range). BlueWave embedding pilot moved to stage 2.
- Runtime: small kernel patch reduced memory jitter on 2x sequence long tails; infra flagged as green for dedicated pool scheduling.

Risks / Hazards:
- Acme procurement timeline compressed — legal wants SLA language and a one-time credit ask in the term sheet. If we need CCO signoff, that could slip the close by ~2 weeks.
- QBR deck: a couple of product owners still missing OKR slide updates (model sizing and cost-per-token comparisons).

Asks (clear owners & deadlines):
1) Laura — confirm whether we can approve the one-time credit up to $12k without exec escalation. Need answer by EOD Friday (2027-05-21). Related HubSpot: DEAL-4592.
2) Marissa — please attach the latest Acme comms snapshot and a one-slide summary for the QBR (metrics + decision ask). Due: EOD Thursday (2027-05-20).
3) Jonas — consolidate the model-sizing slide and add the updated serving runtime note (two bullets). Due: Friday morning.
4) Soojin — if we need to escalate an exception for SLA, please advise fallback owners.

Attachments: QBR-runbook-v1.pdf (working outline), Acme-comms-snapshot.xlsx (metrics). Drive: https://drive.redwood.com/s/abc123/QBR-runbook

Short meeting suggestion: 30m sync tomorrow 10:30am PT if folks are available to walk the Acme ask and final slide ownership. If not, reply with owner/ack and I'll compile.

Thanks —
Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Head of Product Ops, Redwood Inference

Karthik — thanks for the crisp note. Quick clarification: when you say "one-time credit up to $12k", is that a commercial concession tied to a 12-month commit, or an unconditional credit? If it's tied to commit length we can likely approve at the GTM level; unconditional credits need CCO.

If you can drop a single-sentence clarification here, I'll route through the right approver. Also, I'm available for the 10:30am sync tomorrow if we need to run it.

Best,
Laura
Laura Bennett
VP, GTM Ops, Redwood Inference

Karthik / Laura — attaching the snapshot and a one-slide QBR summary as requested. Highlights below and action items are bolded.

Highlights (Acme):
- Usage: test pool reached 2.1M tokens/day last week (expected ramp).
- Quality: human eval spot-checks show parity with baseline prompts for the targeted intents.
- Cost: 14% below modeled cost with current batching & prefix cache.

Actionable items I completed:
- Attached Acme-comms-snapshot.xlsx (tabs: metrics, timeline, outstanding-legal-asks).
- Drafted QBR slide (attached in QBR-runbook-v1.pdf, page 6) — includes the recommended one-time credit as a conditional concession tied to 12-month commit.

Open asks (need decisions):
- Legal language for SLA: legal wants commercial signoff on proposed credit/term. If GTM confirms conditional credit approach (12-month commit), legal can proceed without CCO.
- Slide owner: Jonas to take model-sizing; Karthik to finalize the decision text on slide.

Attachments: Acme-comms-snapshot.xlsx, updated QBR-runbook-v1.pdf (page 6 highlighted).

Marissa
Sr. Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference

Thanks team — closure summary below so the leadership distro has one canonical thread to pull from for the QBR: 

Decisions made / confirmations:
- Credit approach: conditional concession tied to a 12-month commit. GTM (Laura) confirmed route; legal can proceed without CCO escalation. (Laura, please confirm via the HubSpot comment thread).
- Slide owners: Jonas -> model-sizing; Marissa -> customer metrics slide; Karthik -> decision text and handoff.

Next steps (owners & deadlines):
- Marissa: finalize Acme snapshot and confirm the timeline tab rows by EOD Thursday (2027-05-20). (Completed, see attachment).
- Jonas: consolidate model-sizing bullets and paste into the QBR deck by 9:00am PT Friday (2027-05-21).
- Karthik: I will finalize the decision ask language and incorporate legal note into the QBR-runbook by Friday noon.
- Laura: add HubSpot note and approve commercial path.

I scheduled a 30m sync for Friday 10:30am PT to walk the final deck. If you can't make it, please reply-all with final ack or the name of the delegate who will present.

—Soojin
Soojin Lee
VP, Product Operations, Redwood Inference
